evidence.sourceTitle: Esports World Model Dataset official release documentation
evidence.locator: Scale; Formats: StarCraft II, Dota 2, Counter-Strike 2
evidence.statement: The StarCraft II schema aligns step/action records with current and next observations, timestamps, frame indices and boundaries. Dota 2 and CS2 releases document replay-clock alignment, partial visibility and per-view files. Published manifests distinguish completed data from estimates.
